findings: The helper receives immutable borrows of status, receipt.reason() and outcome.as_ref().err(). It cannot consume or overwrite either original error or the retirement receipt.

The sole production call occurs after the existing status state/granted/faulted assignments and before PressureAudit consumes the receipt. The original audit, terminal status, status.faulted handling and return outcome are byte-preserved outside the one inserted call.

The helper maps each optional cause separately. UTF-8 bytes are encoded exactly as lowercase hex; missing cause remains JSON null. Embedded newlines cannot inject an additional line into the owned diagnostic.

writeln returns an io::Result that is explicitly ignored. A returned write error does not replace the original lifecycle result or create retirement authority. Healthy/no-cause paths return before writing.

The four added source controls cover both causes and unchanged originals, healthy silence, raw UTF-8/newline encoding, and a real broken UnixStream writer. These controls were read but not executed by this reviewer.
limits: No Rust compiler or tests were run by this reviewer. This does not replace the matching build or actual Owner runtime.

This is not a guarantee against allocator abort, arbitrary Write implementation panics, blocking sinks, or loss of a diagnostic if the output fails. No such broader guarantee is needed to claim that returned io::Errors are ignored.
The original Owner10 cause remains whatever its actual retirement receipt reports; this source review does not establish that cause.
scope: Full 6021-byte frozen delta plus actual joined-receipt consumer, source-only
